name: Barmenia Versicherungen a.G. (BarmeniaGothaer Group)
note: German mutual insurer (Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit) in Wuppertal; with Gothaer Versicherungsbank VVaG it stands at the top of the BarmeniaGothaer group, steered financially by BarmeniaGothaer AG. Owned by its policyholder members.
